show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: John Kim - How to Raise a Few Billion Dollars - [Invest Like the Best, EP.482]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: John is one of the world's top and most prolific fundraisers.
reader_summary.overview: John is one of the world's top and most prolific fundraisers. He was chief client officer at General Catalyst, where he helped raise many of the firm's flagship funds. He is now chairman and president of corporate development at Lila Sciences, a company building scientific superintelligence, where he has helped raise several hundred million dollars.

key_points.text: He is also the author of The Tao of Fundraising.
This conversation is really a guide on how to raise money from someone who has done it at the highest level.
We talk about why persuasion equals desire minus fear, the difference between belief and trust, the laws of fundraising.
